program.name: Bell HIIT Long
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Long HIIT with one kettlebell: an EMOM and Tabatas, or a circuit and an AMRAP.
program.about: High-intensity work built around one kettlebell. One day is an EMOM of swings, snatches and squats, then Tabatas mixing the bell with jumps; the other is a circuit of the same, then an AMRAP of swings and burpees. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Bell EMOM & Tabatas / bell circuit & AMRAP
